disambiguation: Not a simple text replacement tool; it supports complex dynamic tokens, shell execution, and date pickers.
extras: Desktop-only plugin. Supports running user-authored local shell commands.
intentEvidence: Slasher lets you create custom editor commands that appear in Obsidian's command system
problem: Users need a way to generate complex, dynamic note content using system data, dates, or shell execution directly from a command.
summary: Slasher allows users to define custom commands that execute templates containing dynamic variables, dates, and shell commands within the Obsidian editor.
